summary.text: Bryan Ward is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 86, listed with Hardy County. His legislative page lists him as vice chair of the Homeland Security Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ward's page gives his birth date as September 15, 1965, and lists his occupation as retired sheriff, retired firefighter and paramedic, carpenter and farmer.
It names his spouse as Cheryl and lists a child, Marissa.
Ward also serves on the House's Courts, Education, Judiciary and Public Education committees.
